title: Vulcan Provider Manifest v2
description: Declarative provider capability manifest: services, protocol routes, model rules, profiles, operations, upload channels, and tool targets.

default_usage_scopes.description: Initial usage defaults only; explicit user model choices may enable or disable conversation and non-conversation internal use independently.

session_header.description: Optional request header name that receives the current public session identifier.

capability_patch.description: Field-level capability patch with Inherit/Clear/Set presence (plan 6.4): omitted fields inherit, null clears only nullable fields, values replace.
